description.en: A 16–50 mm X-mount zoom. The manufacturer lists a 24–76 mm full-frame-equivalent field of view; the physical focal-length range remains 16–50 mm.
description.zh-cn: 一支 16–50 mm 的 X 卡口变焦镜头。厂商标注其全画幅等效视角为 24–76 mm，实际焦距范围仍为 16–50 mm。

sources.title: XF16-50mmF2.8-4.8 R LM WR Specifications
sources.locator: Focal length (35mm format equivalent); Max. aperture; Min. aperture
sources.supports: The 16–50 mm focal-length range, manufacturer-stated 24–76 mm equivalence, F2.8–F4.8 maximum aperture, and F22 minimum aperture.
